creative_direction.summary: A restrained scientific-documentary journey from a predawn Pacific horizon through ocean instruments, evidence, infrastructure, and a final return to the sea.
global_constraints: no generated text after the exact title frame
deep Pacific blue, warm white, and cyan accent palette

scenes.title: PACIFIC INSTRUMENT
scenes.description: An exact Pacific Instrument title field opens the sequence before yielding to a wide predawn ocean horizon.

scenes.title: SURFACE RECORD
scenes.description: The camera descends toward a single scientific buoy whose sensors begin recording the changing surface conditions.

scenes.title: WATER COLUMN
scenes.description: A roulette aperture moves the view below the surface to reveal a vertical column of measured temperature and light.

scenes.title: SUBSEA LINK
scenes.description: Hamonshu lines become current traces around a seabed instrument package and a cable carrying measurements toward shore.

scenes.title: SHORE STATION
scenes.description: The cable reaches a quiet shore station where incoming observations resolve into restrained lines and numeric records.

scenes.title: TEN MEASURES
scenes.description: A roulette form organizes ten simultaneous measurements into a quiet radial instrument without implying unavailable precision.

scenes.title: EVIDENCE FIELD
scenes.description: Wave forms separate observed measurements from modeled intervals while retaining their explicit evidence status.

scenes.title: PORT INTERFACE
scenes.description: A mechanical roulette aperture opens from the evidence field onto a night port where ocean observations meet infrastructure.

scenes.title: READING THE RECORD
scenes.description: A human reader studies the record at a large table, connecting the visual instrument back to scientific documentation.

scenes.title: THE RECORD REMAINS
scenes.description: The sequence returns to the Pacific horizon and closes on an exact end title carried by a final restrained Hamonshu field.
